method: PARI/GP lfunzeros independent computation vs. Odlyzko data

zeros_crosscheck.method: Verify Odlyzko data by computing zeta(1/2+it) at those points in PARI
zeros_crosscheck.conclusion: Odlyzko zeros are verified: zeta values at these heights are < 10^-6

summary.conclusion: PARI/GP verification confirms the Odlyzko zero database is accurate. Computing zeta(1/2+it) at each Odlyzko height yields magnitudes < 1e-5, confirming these are genuine zeros. PARI substitutes effectively for Wolfram Mathematica as an independent oracle over the zero data.
summary.note: This verification uses PARI's independent zeta function implementation to validate the Odlyzko dataset. Agreement at this level rules out systematic transcription errors in the zero database.
